axis: No two artifacts occupy the same state. No boilerplate duplication. Each section unique.

questions.question: REQUIRED: No section header appears twice in the document?
Are repeated sentence starters ('We will', 'Our') used <8x each?

patterns: \b(In conclusion|To summarize|In summary,|In closing,|As mentioned earlier|As stated above)\b
questions.question: Zero use of stock executive-summary closing phrases ('In conclusion', 'To summarize', 'In summary')?
Each major phase (Foundation/Activation/Scale) has distinct deliverables, not just rephrased same content?
REQUIRED: No paragraph (≥80 chars) appears twice verbatim?
Each engagement tier (Diagnostic, Activation, Transformation) has different deliverables enumerated?
Optional: zero use of 'we will deliver' more than 4x?
